+++ b/models/utils_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+//go:build !scanner
+
+package models
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	cvedict "github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/models"
+)
+
+func TestConvertNvdToModelCvss40(t *testing.T) {
+	const cveID = "CVE-2024-1234"
+	contents, _, _ := ConvertNvdToModel(cveID, []cvedict.Nvd{{
+		Descriptions: []cvedict.NvdDescription{{Value: "description"}},
+		Cvss3: []cvedict.NvdCvss3{{
+			Source: "nvd@nist.gov",
+			Cvss3:  cvedict.Cvss3{BaseScore: 7.1},
+		}},
+		Cvss40: []cvedict.NvdCvss40{
+			{Source: "nvd@nist.gov", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 8.2, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/NVD", BaseSeverity: "HIGH"}},
+			{Source: "vendor@example.com", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 5.3, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/VENDOR", BaseSeverity: "MEDIUM"}},
+		},
+	}})
+	if len(contents) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %d NVD contents, want 2", len(contents))
+	}
+	bySource := make(map[string]CveContent)
+	for _, content := range contents {
+		if content.Type != Nvd || content.CveID != cveID {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected content identity: %+v", content)
+		}
+		bySource[content.Optional["source"]] = content
+	}
+	if got := bySource["nvd@nist.gov"]; got.Cvss3Score != 7.1 || got.Cvss40Score != 8.2 || got.Cvss40Vector != "CVSS:4.0/NVD" || got.Cvss40Severity != "HIGH" {
+		t.Errorf("NVD metrics were not kept together: %+v", got)
+	}
+	if got := bySource["vendor@example.com"]; got.Cvss40Score != 5.3 || got.Cvss40Vector != "CVSS:4.0/VENDOR" || got.Cvss40Severity != "MEDIUM" || got.Cvss3Score != 0 {
+		t.Errorf("vendor metrics were not source-specific: %+v", got)
+	}
+}

+++ b/models/utils_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+//go:build !scanner
+
+package models
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	cvedict "github.com/vulsio/go-cve-dictionary/models"
+)
+
+func TestConvertNvdToModelCvss40(t *testing.T) {
+	const cveID = "CVE-2024-1234"
+	contents, _, _ := ConvertNvdToModel(cveID, []cvedict.Nvd{{
+		Descriptions: []cvedict.NvdDescription{{Value: "description"}},
+		Cvss3: []cvedict.NvdCvss3{{
+			Source: "nvd@nist.gov",
+			Cvss3:  cvedict.Cvss3{BaseScore: 7.1},
+		}},
+		Cvss40: []cvedict.NvdCvss40{
+			{Source: "nvd@nist.gov", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 8.2, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/NVD", BaseSeverity: "HIGH"}},
+			{Source: "vendor@example.com", Cvss40: cvedict.Cvss40{BaseScore: 5.3, VectorString: "CVSS:4.0/VENDOR", BaseSeverity: "MEDIUM"}},
+		},
+	}})
+	if len(contents) != 2 {
+		t.Fatalf("got %d NVD contents, want 2", len(contents))
+	}
+	bySource := make(map[string]CveContent)
+	for _, content := range contents {
+		if content.Type != Nvd || content.CveID != cveID {
+			t.Errorf("unexpected content identity: %+v", content)
+		}
+		bySource[content.Optional["source"]] = content
+	}
+	if got := bySource["nvd@nist.gov"]; got.Cvss3Score != 7.1 || got.Cvss40Score != 8.2 || got.Cvss40Vector != "CVSS:4.0/NVD" || got.Cvss40Severity != "HIGH" {
+		t.Errorf("NVD metrics were not kept together: %+v", got)
+	}
+	if got := bySource["vendor@example.com"]; got.Cvss40Score != 5.3 || got.Cvss40Vector != "CVSS:4.0/VENDOR" || got.Cvss40Severity != "MEDIUM" || got.Cvss3Score != 0 {
+		t.Errorf("vendor metrics were not source-specific: %+v", got)
+	}
+}
